_README: The B-LEG bot. IT IS ON THE BENCH: account is null, so it trades nothing, the boot sequence skips it and the runner refuses to start it. It exists so that adding a second bot to an account is something Aaron can do from the command center (Bots -> Accounts -> Add bot) rather than something that needs a code change. Assigning it writes the account, the server, the terminal path and the account's risk cap in one action. READ _NOT_VALIDATED BELOW BEFORE ASSIGNING IT. No secrets live here; the MT5 password comes from algos/credentials.json under mt5_accounts, keyed by the account number it is assigned to.
_NOT_VALIDATED: DO NOT PUT THIS ON A LIVE OR DEMO ACCOUNT YET. b_leg's Pine<->Python parity gate has NOT been re-run since its defaults moved on 2026-08-06 (bleg_max_days 1.25 -> 4.0, exec_trail_pct 1.0 -> 0.05, exec_time_stop_hrs 36 -> 8). Every TradingView export on disk decodes the OLD values, so compare_bleg.py cannot check today's build and the last green run describes a strategy that no longer exists - the exact 'exercised before its own rewrite' trap recorded in command-center/CLAUDE.md. That needs a fresh export from TradingView, which only a human can produce. Tracked as G15 in docs/LIVE_TRADING_PIPELINE.md. It is also UNPROMOTED (strategy_source_hash empty), so it would import from the repo working tree rather than a frozen snapshot - promote it before it ever runs.
_strategy_params: Every field of BLegConfig, DUMPED from the dataclass rather than transcribed - a hand-copied set is how a live bot ends up trading a value nobody chose. RE-DUMPED 2026-09-07 and the reason matters more than the fix: the original dump was taken on 2026-08-09 and was COMPLETE THAT DAY, but a dump is a SNAPSHOT and the dataclass kept growing - 57 fields had been added since and every one of them resolved to whatever today's default happened to be. The note you are reading said 'every field' throughout, so the file asserted a completeness it had quietly lost, and nothing could fail. THE ONE THAT BIT: exec_scale_in (add size to a winning position) arrived 2026-08-16 and its default moved False -> True on 2026-09-06, so arming this bot would have started it scaling in - a behaviour never measured on B-LEG and one its Pine parity gate cannot check, because the B-LEG export scheme has no column for it. It is PINNED FALSE here, which is a deliberate override of the dataclass default and the only value in this re-dump that is not simply the current default. exec_recovery was the next one waiting: unpinned, and inert today only because its default is still False. Everything else added is behaviour-neutral by construction - a pin equal to the default changes nothing - and the 60 values pinned before this were not touched. Three are live-side overrides of the lab defaults and each is a fact about the broker rather than about the strategy: account_profile puprime_standard (the lab default is vantage_demo, a different broker's measured costs), symbol XAUUSD.s (PU Prime's own symbol string) and mintick/point_value matching gold on that terminal. account_profile is INERT live - it only prices fills when fill_model is 'tick', which the bridge refuses - and is set correctly anyway so the file never claims Vantage while trading PU Prime. THE STANDING RULE: a dumped config is only complete on the day it is dumped, so re-dump before assigning this bot and diff it - a field that appears with a default nobody chose is the failure this file has already had once.
_magic: 770116, one above sos_fade_demo's 770115 and deliberately different. live_config._assert_magic_is_unique REFUSES to start two bots that share a magic on ONE account: every read in mt5_ops.py filters by it, so two bots sharing one would each read the OTHER's orders as their own - cancel them, ratchet their stops and book their fills. The guard is per ACCOUNT and exempts a benched bot, so it is not enforcing anything today; the number is chosen now so that assigning this bot is never blocked by it.
_account_risk_cap_pct: null today, and on a benched bot this field means nothing either way - there is no account for a ceiling to describe, and live_config._assert_account_cap_agrees exempts the bench precisely so a leftover number here cannot block anything. The cap is an ACCOUNT-level fact stored per instance, and every bot on one account must state the SAME value or none of them will start, so assigning this bot through the command center ADOPTS the account's cap in the same write. NOTE - taking a bot OFF an account writes only 'account: null' and LEAVES this value behind, so a bot that has been on an account and come back will carry that account's old cap while benched. That is deliberate (it makes re-assignment cheap and it is inert on the bench) and it is why this number must not be read as a claim about anything. Do not set it by hand; set it on Bots -> Accounts, which writes it to every bot on the account at once.
_exec_risk_pct: 10% per trade, inherited from the strategy's own config, and DELIBERATELY LEFT AT 10 rather than guessed down - see the WARNING below, this number is an open decision. WARNING - THIS FIELD IS STALE THE MOMENT IT DESCRIBES ANOTHER BOT, and both halves of what it used to say went false on 2026-09-03: sos_fade_demo no longer risks 10% (Aaron moved it to 5.0), and the live account is 700152905, not the 700107749 this note named for weeks. A per-instance note that quotes a SIBLING bot's setting is a copy of a number nobody updates when the original moves; read the sibling's own config, and treat everything here about another bot as needing a check. WHAT THE SPLIT ACTUALLY IS, 2026-09-03, Aaron's call: 'extreme will be 5% and sos fade will be 5%'. Two shares of 5 summing to the 10% account cap exactly, so each bot can hold one full-size trade at once and the budget is fully allocated with THIS BOT GETTING NOTHING. It is benched, so that costs nothing today. WARNING - THE ARITHMETIC HAS NO ROOM FOR A THIRD BOT AND THAT IS THE UNDECIDED PART: assigning this bot to that account at any positive risk makes the shares sum to MORE than the cap, at which point the three do not share the budget, they take turns - whoever is first fills it and the others are REFUSED until room comes back. Moving this field to 5.0 would NOT fix that; it would make three 5% shares against a 10% cap. So the decision to take before this bot is ever assigned is what the cap becomes and how it splits three ways, and only then what this number is. Do not set it by hand as part of an assignment - see the note on the account cap above.
_mt5_path: The MT5_FFT terminal, matching sos_fade_demo. It is a placeholder while this bot is benched - assigning it to an account ADOPTS that account's terminal path, because the terminal has to be logged into the account the bot claims to trade and only the bots already on it know which one that is.
